title: Ordinary etale compact-support projections: tensor associativity and composition on arbitrary bases
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. On $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ use the ordinary unbounded etale operations of [lem-sf-etale-ambient-adjoint-projection]. For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of arbitrary schemes supplied with an open-then-proper factorization, let
$$q_f(M,P):F_f(M\otimes_A^Lf^*P)\xrightarrow{\sim}F_fM\otimes_A^LP$$
be the inverse of its canonical compactification projection map. It is natural in both $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $P\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Write $\otimes=\otimes_A^L$, and insert the canonical derived tensor associators and pullback tensor comparisons [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]. For every $M,P,Q$ in these categories the following equality holds, with source $F_f(M\otimes f^*(P\otimes Q))$ and target $(F_fM\otimes P)\otimes Q$:
$$q_f(M,P\otimes Q)=(q_f(M,P)\otimes1_Q)\circ q_f(M\otimes f^*P,Q).$$
For $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ and $h=gf$, supply all three morphisms with open-then-proper factorizations. The compact-support comparison of [lem-etale-unbounded-compact-support-composition] can be taken to be the graph-factorization comparison: embed the source compactifications in the product of their proper parts, use the resulting closed immersions into opens, and then proper/open interchange. For this normalized comparison $E:F_h\xrightarrow{\sim}F_gF_f$, one has for every $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$
$$(E_M\otimes1_K)\circ q_h(M,K)=q_g(F_fM,K)\circ F_g(q_f(M,g^*K))\circ E_{M\otimes h^*K}.$$
The equation uses the canonical $h^*K\cong f^*g^*K$. Both identities concern the specified derived morphisms on the entire unbounded categories. No Noetherianity or quasi-compactness of the schemes or the open parts of the factorizations is assumed.

proof.text: Write $P_u=u^*$, $R_u=Ru_*$ and $J_j=Dj_!$. Put $\pi_u$ for the counit-defined forward projection and $\delta_j$ for the forward open tensor comparison. Thus for $f=rj$ the specified forward compactification projection is $p_f=R_r(\delta_j)\circ\pi_r$ (with pullback composition inserted), and $q_f=p_f^{-1}$. These maps and inverses are bifunctorially natural: the defining unit and counit, the tensor bifunctor and the open comparison are natural in both arguments; invert a naturality square by multiplying by the two inverse components. Invertibility on all unbounded objects is precisely [lem-sf-etale-ambient-adjoint-projection]. The canonical derived pullback constraints are symmetric monoidal and composition-compatible by [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]; specialize its ringed topoi to constant $A$, so derived module pullback is the exact $u^*$.

proof.text: For tensor associativity use the proved source theorem projectionMapOfCompactification_assoc on the supplied compactification. Rewrite its pullback comparison using leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso_hom. Cancel the invertible projection components, reverse their order, and use inv_whiskerRight and functoriality to identify the inverses. Perform this cancellation for a generic coefficient category, and use kernel-checked heterogeneous congruence and the derived tensor object/map APIs to specialize to ModuleCat A without unfolding the large concrete derived monoidal structure. This proves sfEtaleCompactProjectionInverse_associativity with precisely its specified associators.
